task_description: Add XML and YAML parsing support for SBOM formats (CycloneDX and SPDX) with updated format detection and comprehensive tests using self-created inline mock data

verification.summary: go build ./... succeeds. All 26 tests in ./internal/sbom/... pass (9 existing + 17 new). Tests cover CycloneDX XML/YAML and SPDX XML/YAML parsing including dev detection, skip-no-purl, empty components, and format detection for all 6 encoding variants plus error cases. Test mocks are all inline with realistic data structures matching official specs.
